assumptions: The channel is linear DNA content (area); nuclei of one sample sit in a G1 peak, a G2 peak near twice it, and S phase between.
With a standard, the standard and the sample were stained and run together in one tube.
limits: Up to six samples per histogram; peaks below the debris limit are not used to start the fit.
The reduced chi-square is flowPloidy's goodness-of-fit guide (0.7–4 acceptable), not a test.
bio.jane/contract.question: What are the cell-cycle phases and DNA content in this DNA-stained sample?

description: flowPloidy's DNA-content (cell cycle, genome size) fit on one channel of a project FCS file, optionally one population: G1/G2 Gaussians per sample, broadened-rectangle S phase, debris and aggregates by bounded nlsLM; nuclei counts, G1 CVs, G2/G1 linearity, reduced chi-square; with a standard, the ratio and pg; without G2, the endoreduplication index.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

debris.description: the debris model. Values: SC (single cut), MC (multiple cut).

debris_limit.description: peaks below this bin are not used as starting peaks.

document.description: the FCS file in the project, by name or id.

g2.description: model G2 peaks; off for endopolyploid tissue (then the endoreduplication index is reported).

gating.description: a Gating-ML or FlowJo .wsp in the project; empty for none.

linearity.description: the G2/G1 ratio: fitted between 1.5 and 2.5, or held at 2. Values: variable (fitted), fixed (fixed at 2).

population.description: a population of the strategy to analyze (flowPloidy gate); empty for every event.

samples_in_tube.description: how many samples (sets of G1/G2/S peaks) the model may hold.

standard.description: which sample's G1 is the internal standard (a: lower G1, b: higher); empty for none.

standard_size.description: the standard's DNA content in pg (0 for none).

trim_raw.description: drop channel values at or above this (0 keeps every value).

name: analyze_flow_cytometry_ploidy

fit.description: the fitted parameters by name, stop code, iterations, nuclei counts per component, G1 CVs and the reduced chi-square; null when refused

histogram.description: counts per bin, events outside the population, the fitted bins, and the starting peaks

summary.description: ratio to the standard, DNA content (pg) and endoreduplication index, each null when it does not apply
